negative_reviews.author: Emma Turnbull
negative_reviews.text: Went with my sister for lunch the other day. Food was absolutely amazing as always but sadly the service was horrible. Almost every time iv been to this location so far despite it being quite quiet when I go we end up left waiting for service for ages with the shortest being 25 minutes waiting for our bill after they took our plates. This time after they had taken our plates and cups my sister an I were left for a whole hour without a single person coming over to ask for the bill and when we where about to ask someone for the bill they were always shooting past us. I understand being a server is a hard job but leaving a table for an hour while another table was sat beside us given their food and paid within that time is ridiculous. And when we mentioned it while paying all we got was an annoyed look from the staff.
